newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France injects 100 mln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France injects 100 mln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France injected 100 million francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Friday to allocate funds for injection into the money market the same day.
It accepted bids for 38.2 billion francs in new liquidity, 100 million more than the 38.1 billion leaving the market on Friday. The new pact expires on May 16.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.3 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 3.9 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 26.9 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 11.1 percent of this demand.
